items.title: Session expiry and permission changes (197, 230).
items.expected: Distinguish expired session and role refusal; preserve safe context without mutation replay.
items.observed: `services/api.ts:request` protects against cross-tab token changes, including slow JSON decoding, but a current-session 401 or 403 only becomes a local `ApiRequestError`. A token can remain installed and the protected screen can remain interactive after expiry. Add one frontend expiry presentation/lifecycle that blocks repeated failed submissions, distinguishes expiry from role refusal, protects safe unsaved context, and never replays a mutation. Prove an expired in-flight save remains uncertain and that reauthentication requires deliberate resubmission. Do not treat the passing two-tab sign-out test as evidence for this different case.
